use onc_rpc_xdr::{XdrDecode, XdrEncode};

pub type job_update_t = u32;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct instance_info_t {
    pub source_handle: crate::nfs_support::remote_handle_t,
}

impl XdrEncode for instance_info_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.source_handle.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for instance_info_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            source_handle: <crate::nfs_support::remote_handle_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for instance_info_t {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        output.opaque(&self.source_handle, Some(crate::nfs_support::REMOTE_HANDLE_SIZE as usize))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct job_result_t {
    pub status: crate::common_types::status_code_t,
}

impl XdrEncode for job_result_t {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.status.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for job_result_t {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            status: <crate::common_types::status_code_t as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for job_result_t {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.status, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct instance_info_tMetadata {
    pub source_handle: crate::nfs_support::remote_handle_tMetadata,
}

impl XdrDecode for instance_info_tMetadata {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            source_handle: <crate::nfs_support::remote_handle_tMetadata as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata for instance_info_tMetadata {
    const MAX_PREFIX_BYTES: usize = 4;
    fn opaque_len(&self) -> Option<usize> { onc_rpc_xdr::XdrReplyMetadata::opaque_len(&self.source_handle) }
}

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct instance_info_tSegments {
    pub source_handle: crate::nfs_support::remote_handle_tSegments,
}

impl XdrEncode for instance_info_tSegments {
    fn encode_xdr(&self, output: &mut bytes::BytesMut) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        self.source_handle.encode_xdr(output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl XdrDecode for instance_info_tSegments {
    fn decode_xdr(input: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<Self, onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        Ok(Self {
            source_handle: <crate::nfs_support::remote_handle_tSegments as XdrDecode>::decode_xdr(input)?,
        })
    }
}

impl onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments for instance_info_tSegments {
    fn encode_xdr_segments(&self, output: &mut onc_rpc_xdr::SegmentEncoder) -> Result<(), onc_rpc_xdr::XdrError> {
        onc_rpc_xdr::XdrEncodeSegments::encode_xdr_segments(&self.source_handle, output)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

impl From<instance_info_t> for instance_info_tSegments {
    fn from(value: instance_info_t) -> Self { Self {
        source_handle: value.source_handle.into(),
    } }
}
